name: Yuki
source:
With an unknown birthdate, all that is known about her birth is that she is the sole surviving member of the Samakuze Clan, which was wiped out 20 years ago. Found by a warlord, Yuki was trained in the arts of assassination from a very young age. Her kill count being in the thousands, she has become desensitized to killing… or has she?

[In game description]
